# truefoundry_custom_endpoint_account (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry AI Gateway custom endpoint provider account: arbitrary HTTP services proxied by the gateway at /proxy-api/{account-name}/{endpoint-name}, optionally load balanced. Applied as a `provider-account/custom-endpoint` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. Existing accounts can be imported by their FQN, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_custom_endpoint_account.example my-tenant:custom-endpoint:my-account`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single endpoint proxied at /proxy-api/speech/transcribe.
resource "truefoundry_custom_endpoint_account" "speech" {
  name          = "speech"
  endpoint_type = "azure-speech-service"

  endpoints = [
    {
      name     = "transcribe"
      base_url = "https://my-speech.cognitiveservices.azure.com"

      # Secret references are recommended; raw values also work.
      auth_headers = {
        "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::tfy/speech/key"
      }
    },
  ]
}

# Two endpoints load balanced by weight, reachable together at
# /proxy-api/internal-llm/main and individually by endpoint name.
resource "truefoundry_custom_endpoint_account" "internal_llm" {
  name         = "internal-llm"
  routing_type = "weight"
  slug         = "main"

  endpoints = [
    {
      name     = "eu"
      base_url = "https://llm-eu.internal.example.com/v1"
      loadbalancing = {
        weight = 80
      }
    },
    {
      name     = "us"
      base_url = "https://llm-us.internal.example.com/v1"
      loadbalancing = {
        weight                = 20
        fallback_candidate    = true
        fallback_status_codes = ["429", "500", "503"]
      }
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `endpoints` (Attributes List) Upstream endpoints proxied through this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `name` (String) Name of the custom endpoint account (3-32 characters; must start with a lowercase letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Changing it replaces the account.

### Optional

- `collaborators` (Attributes Set, Deprecated) Subjects with a role on this custom endpoint account; use `truefoundry_role_binding` instead. Unset leaves the grants on the control plane untouched (and they are not tracked); an empty set clears them, which is only accepted until 15 Nov 2026. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collaborators))
- `endpoint_type` (String) Type of service behind the endpoints, used for tracking. One of: `azure-speech-service`, `other`.
- `routing_type` (String) Load balancing across the endpoints: `weight` or `priority`. Unset means each endpoint is only reachable individually at /proxy-api/{account-name}/{endpoint-name}.
- `slug` (String) Identifier of the load balancer, reachable at /proxy-api/{account-name}/{slug}/{upstream-path}. Required when `routing_type` is set.

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the custom endpoint account.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the custom endpoint account.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Required:

- `base_url` (String) Target base URL requests are proxied to, e.g. https://my-service.example.com/v1.
- `name` (String) Name identifying this endpoint.

Optional:

- `auth_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Authentication headers sent to the upstream on every request, e.g. {"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" = "..."}. Values accept TrueFoundry secret references (recommended); the control plane returns them as stored, so drift is detected.
- `authorized_subjects` (Set of String) Subjects allowed to access this endpoint, as `<user_type>:<username>` FQNs.
- `headers` (Map of String) Non-secret custom headers forwarded to the upstream with every request.
- `loadbalancing` (Attributes) Per-endpoint load balancing settings. Requires `routing_type` on the account; `weight` for weight routing (weights must sum to 100), `priority` for priority routing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--loadbalancing))
- `tls` (Attributes) TLS verification settings for the upstream connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--tls))

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--loadbalancing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.loadbalancing`

Optional:

- `fallback_candidate` (Boolean) Whether this endpoint may serve as a fallback for other endpoints.
- `fallback_status_codes` (Set of String) Status codes for which the request falls back to other endpoints.
- `metadata_match` (Map of String) Metadata key-value pairs that must match incoming request metadata headers for this endpoint to be considered.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the endpoint; 0 is highest (priority routing).
- `weight` (Number) Relative routing weight; weights across all endpoints must sum to 100 (weight routing).


<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.tls`

Required:

- `reject_unauthorized` (Boolean) Reject connections not authorized by the configured CAs.

Optional:

- `ca_cert` (String) Custom CA certificate(s) used for TLS verification.



<a id="nestedatt--collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collaborators`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) Role to assign, e.g. provider-account-access.
- `subject` (String) Subject FQN, e.g. user:jane@example.com or team:everyone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Custom endpoint accounts are imported by their FQN: <tenant>:custom-endpoint:<name>.
terraform import truefoundry_custom_endpoint_account.speech my-tenant:custom-endpoint:speech
```
